en-US.description: The PDF workbench; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
The PDF workbench; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Acrobat, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Read, organize, combine, split and secure PDFs in a fast, native app, written in Rust from the ground up.
PdfCraft renders PDFs with care for the details that make a page feel right: kerning and ligatures, right-to-left and complex scripts, vertical CJK, colour emoji, shadings, blend modes, soft masks and optional content.
Combine files merges any number of PDFs into one. Each file gets a bookmark, with its own bookmarks nested underneath. Extract copies the pages you select into a new document. Split divides a document every n pages, or before the pages you choose.

en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- M2: a reference in a colour space or array isn't lost: Indexed tables, Pattern spaces, /Decode, /W and functions by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5539
- fix(render): a JBIG2 page's segments are bounded in what they hold and refer to (hayro-jbig2 patches 5 to 9, hayro-syntax 29) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5491
- Reject signed and empty arcs in try_oid by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5581
- Ignore a negative trailer /Size in incremental saves by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5566
- tests(engine): the XFA opening scale test times its small and large forms in the same rounds by @guillehr2 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5586
- M3: the wheel scrolls right after Alt+Tab back, before the mouse moves (#1518) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5608
- M10: Create ▸ Blank page uses the system region's paper (#5644) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5651
- M14: the comments panel lays out only the cards in view (#5488) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5583
- M8: typing the last page of a range keeps what is typed (#5574) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5579
- fix(create): a /Decode array needs two finite numbers to invert an export by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5678
- Make MCP aligns enums compatible with Kimi by @Barzabel in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5592
- M2: a shrunk image on a turned or mirrored page snaps to whole pixels (#5530) by @MichaelMuClaude in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5640
- M8: redaction clears the covered pixels of JBIG2 scans instead of removing them (protect.redact-image-pixels) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5461
- M11: Monochrome Images averages indexed black-and-white images, the palette saying which sample is dark (optimize.downsample-images) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5471
- M11: Monochrome Images reads JBIG2 scans: averaged like any, and stored again as JBIG2 (optimize.mono-compression) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5472
- M8: a redacted black-and-white scan is stored as Group 4, or JBIG2 again, when smaller (protect.redact-image-pixels) by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5474
- feat(ui,annot): customizable hotbar strip, freehand highlight, and moveable navigation rail by @Arch-amon in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5677
- fix(ui): don't check recent files on the UI thread at startup (#5682) by @Elarionus in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5692
- Fix Matrix::invert rejecting valid matrices with a small scale by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5703
- M7: make page-mark replacement transactional (#5657) by @AdrianTM in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5704
- Repair scan: an object whose header names another generation is still found (#5580) by @Hamza0101 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5584
- Reject '+' sign in page selection numbers by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5715
- ui: modernize preferences dialog with card-based layout by @Combiler01 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5710
- fix(ui): Format text fields read as fields, line up, and fit the Tools pane (#5634) by @RiceDee in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5637
- fix(ui): centre the quick-tools bar in the margin beside the page (#5635) by @RiceDee in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5638
- fix(ui): the rail's page box fits, and the zoom field looks like a field (#5636) by @RiceDee in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5639
- M2.6: the images of a run, and a page's JBIG2 images, share one allowance of decoding by @Piohrun in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5569
- fix(ui): prevent panel resize handle collision with scrollbar (#5730) by @Combiler01 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5740

zh-CN.description: PDF 工作台；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Acrobat 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
PDF 工作台；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Acrobat 净室重实现。
在快速的本地应用中读取、整理、合并、拆分和保护 PDF，从零开始用 Rust 编写。
PdfCraft 的 PDF 渲染注重让页面看起来舒适的细节：字距与连字、从右到左及复杂文字、竖排 CJK、彩色 emoji、着色、混合模式、软蒙版和可选内容。
合并文件可将任意数量的 PDF 合而为一，每个文件都会生成一个书签，其原有书签嵌套其下。提取可将所选页面复制为新文档。拆分可按每 n 页或在所选页面之前分割文档。
